comparison.objective: Raise and reseat a loaded stand by two holes versus tune and lock a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Load transfer while pulling and reseating two pins under unequal assist versus fine setscrew/collar manipulation and repeated impact-response adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Stand raised two 25 mm holes, level and stable within jolt, speed, and wrist-force bounds versus two safe stops within stroke/energy limits and no drift.
comparison.reason: Both involve locking hardware, but one tests indexed height/load transfer while the other tests continuous dynamic calibration.
